azureLogAnalytics.query:
DatabricksJobs
| extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams) // If RequestParams is string
| extend JobId = tostring(Params.jobId)
| where isnotempty(JobId)
| summarize TotalJobs = dcount(JobId) 
| project TotalJobs

let Source = DatabricksDeltaPipelines;
Source
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(90d) .. now())
| where ActionName == "create" 
       or OperationName contains "deltaPipelines/create"
| extend req = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend res_raw = tostring(Response)
| extend res = iff(res_raw startswith "{", parse_json(res_raw), dynamic({}))
| extend res_result = iff(
        isnull(res.result) or tostring(res.result) !startswith "{",
        dynamic({}),
        parse_json(tostring(res.result))
)
| extend PipelineName = tostring(coalesce(
        req.name,
        res_result.effective_settings.name
))
| where isnotnull(PipelineName) and PipelineName != ""
| summarize total_pipelines = dcount(PipelineName)

DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RP = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend JobIdRaw = coalesce(RP.jobId, RP.job_id, RP["jobId"], RP["job_id"])
| extend JobId = tolower(trim(@" ""'", tostring(JobIdRaw)))
| where isnotempty(JobId)
      and JobId !in ("null", "undefined", "0")
      // Explicitly exclude these job IDs
      and JobId !in (
            "355358348606857",
            "908543307517845",
            "241551409130312",
            "1104276683673165",
            "31208320243706",
            "860999508483754",
            "64096623998108",
            "700121038119701"
      )
| summarize TotalJobs = dcount(JobId)

DatabricksClusters
| extend clusterState = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).clusterState),
         clusterId = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).clusterId)
| where clusterState == "Running"
| summarize ActiveClusters = dcount(clusterId)

DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize 
    TotalJobs = countif(ActionName in ("runSucceeded", "runFailed")),  
    FailedJobs = countif(ActionName == "runFailed")
| project FailureRate = round(FailedJobs * 100.0 / TotalJobs, 1)

DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    TotalJobs = countif(ActionName in ("runSucceeded", "runFailed")),
    SuccessJobs = countif(ActionName == "runSucceeded")
| extend SuccessRate = iff(TotalJobs == 0, 0.0, round((todouble(SuccessJobs) / TotalJobs) * 100, 1))
| project SuccessRate

DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize 
    TotalJobs = countif(ActionName in ("runSucceeded", "runFailed")),  
    SuccessJobs = countif(ActionName == "runSucceeded")
| project SuccessPercent = round(SuccessJobs * 100.0 / TotalJobs, 1)

DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize 
    TotalJobs = countif(ActionName in ("runSucceeded", "runFailed")),  
    FailedJobs = countif(ActionName == "runFailed")
| project FailedPercent = round(FailedJobs * 100.0 / TotalJobs, 1)

DatabricksJobs
| extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend JobId = tostring(Params["jobId"]),
         RunId = tostring(Params["runId"])
| summarize JobsPerHour = dcount(RunId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) asc

DatabricksJobs
| extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend ResponseJson = parse_json(Response)
| extend StatusCode = tostring(ResponseJson.statusCode)
| extend ErrorMessage = tostring(ResponseJson.errorMessage)
| extend RunId = tostring(Params["runId"])
| where StatusCode != "200"  // Non-success codes indicate failure
| summarize FailedJobs = dcount(RunId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) asc

let LatestState = DatabricksClusters
| extend rp = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend clusterId = tostring(coalesce(rp.cluster_id, rp["cluster_id"], rp.clusterId))
| where isnotempty(clusterId)
| where ActionName !has "delete"  // Exclude delete actions
| summarize TimeGenerated = arg_max(TimeGenerated, ActionName) by clusterId
| extend LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| extend ClusterState = case(
    ActionName has "terminate", "Terminated",
    ActionName has "start", "Running",
    ActionName has "create", "Created",
    ActionName has "resize", "Resizing",
    LastSeen < ago(30m), "Inactive",
    "Idle");

let History = DatabricksClusters
| extend rp = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend clusterId = tostring(coalesce(rp.cluster_id, rp["cluster_id"], rp.clusterId))
| where isnotempty(clusterId)
| where ActionName !has "delete"  // Exclude delete actions
| summarize firstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by clusterId;

LatestState
| join kind=leftouter History on clusterId
| extend avgUptimeMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, firstSeen)
| project clusterId, ClusterState, LastSeen, firstSeen, avgUptimeMinutes
| order by LastSeen desc
| take 10

// ================== PARAMETERS ==================
let treatSkippedAsSuccess = 0;

// Keep this as a plain string.
// Do not paste the HTML ... value into the KQL query.
let DatabricksWorkspaceUrl =
    "https://adb-4498671387938000.0.azuredatabricks.net";

// ================== RAW NORMALIZATION ==================
let RunsRaw =
    DatabricksJobs
    | extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
    | extend
        JobId = tostring(
            coalesce(
                column_ifexists("JobId", ""),
                Params["jobId"]
            )
        ),
        RunId = tostring(
            coalesce(
                column_ifexists("RunId", ""),
                Params["runId"]
            )
        ),
        TaskKey = tostring(
            coalesce(
                column_ifexists("taskKey", ""),
                Params["taskKey"]
            )
        )
    | extend ResultRaw = tostring(
        coalesce(
            column_ifexists("ResultState", ""),
            column_ifexists("resultState", ""),
            Params["resultState"],
            Params["taskRunResultState"],
            Params["state"],
            Params["jobTerminalState"]
        )
    )
    | extend EventTime = todatetime(TimeGenerated)
    | where isnotempty(JobId)
        and isnotempty(RunId)
    | where $__timeFilter(EventTime)
;

// ================== TASK-LEVEL RECORDS ==================
let TaskRecords =
    RunsRaw
    | where isnotempty(TaskKey)
    | extend result_upper = toupper(ResultRaw)
    | extend result_class = case(
        result_upper in ("SUCCESS", "SUCCEEDED"), "SUCCESS",
        result_upper == "SKIPPED", "SKIPPED",
        result_upper in (
            "FAILED",
            "FAILURE",
            "ERROR",
            "TERMINATED",
            "TIMEDOUT",
            "TIMEOUT",
            "CANCELED",
            "CANCELLED"
        ), "FAILED",
        "UNKNOWN"
    )
;

// ================== FINAL TASK RESULT ==================
let PerTaskFinal =
    TaskRecords
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, result_class)
        by JobId, RunId, TaskKey
    | project
        JobId,
        RunId,
        TaskKey,
        TaskResult = result_class
;

// ================== SUCCESS STATES ==================
let successStates =
    iff(
        treatSkippedAsSuccess == 1,
        dynamic(["SUCCESS", "SKIPPED"]),
        dynamic(["SUCCESS"])
    );

// ================== RUN TIME BOUNDARIES ==================
// Derives the earliest and latest event time for each run.
let RunTimeBoundaries =
    RunsRaw
    | summarize
        RunStart = min(EventTime),
        RunEnd = max(EventTime)
      by JobId, RunId
    | extend DurationSeconds =
        datetime_diff(
            "second",
            RunEnd,
            RunStart
        )
;

// ================== RUN-LEVEL REDUCTION ==================
let RunOverall_Base =
    PerTaskFinal
    | summarize
        TasksTotal = dcount(TaskKey),
        TasksSucceeded = countif(TaskResult in (successStates))
      by JobId, RunId
    | extend OverallStatus = iff(
        TasksTotal > 0
            and TasksSucceeded == TasksTotal,
        "Succeeded",
        "Failed"
    )
    | join kind=leftouter RunTimeBoundaries on JobId, RunId
    | project
        JobId,
        RunId,
        RunStart,
        RunEnd,
        DurationSeconds,
        OverallStatus,
        TasksTotal,
        TasksSucceeded
    | where isnotempty(RunEnd)
;

// ================== LATEST RUN ==================
// arg_max returns the row having the greatest RunEnd,
// including the duration and status from that same row.
let LatestPerJob =
    RunOverall_Base
    | summarize arg_max(RunEnd, *) by JobId
    | project
        JobId,
        LatestRunId = RunId,
        LatestRun_Start = RunStart,
        LatestRun_End = RunEnd,
        LatestRun_Status = OverallStatus,
        DurationSeconds,
        LatestRun_TasksTotal = TasksTotal,
        LatestRun_TasksSucceeded = TasksSucceeded
;

// ================== MAX DURATION PER JOB ==================
// Maximum duration across runs available in the selected
// Grafana time range.
let MaxDurationPerJob =
    RunOverall_Base
    | summarize
        MaxDurationSeconds = max(DurationSeconds)
      by JobId
;

// ================== PREVIOUS RUN ==================
let Prev1 =
    RunOverall_Base
    | join kind=inner (
        LatestPerJob
        | project
            JobId,
            LatestRun_End
    ) on JobId
    | where RunEnd < LatestRun_End
    | summarize arg_max(RunEnd, *) by JobId
    | project
        JobId,
        PrevRun1_Start = RunStart,
        PrevRun1_End = RunEnd,
        PrevRun1_Status = OverallStatus,
        PrevRun1_DurationSeconds = DurationSeconds
;

// ================== SECOND PREVIOUS RUN ==================
let Prev2 =
    RunOverall_Base
    | join kind=inner (
        Prev1
        | project
            JobId,
            PrevRun1_End
    ) on JobId
    | where RunEnd < PrevRun1_End
    | summarize arg_max(RunEnd, *) by JobId
    | project
        JobId,
        PrevRun2_Start = RunStart,
        PrevRun2_End = RunEnd,
        PrevRun2_Status = OverallStatus,
        PrevRun2_DurationSeconds = DurationSeconds
;

// ================== FINAL OUTPUT ==================
LatestPerJob
| join kind=leftouter MaxDurationPerJob on JobId
| join kind=leftouter Prev1 on JobId
| join kind=leftouter Prev2 on JobId
| extend
    Duration = format_timespan(
        totimespan(DurationSeconds * 1s),
        "hh:mm:ss"
    ),
    MaxDuration = format_timespan(
        totimespan(MaxDurationSeconds * 1s),
        "hh:mm:ss"
    ),
    DatabricksJobUrl = strcat(
        DatabricksWorkspaceUrl,
        "/jobs/",
        tostring(JobId)
    )
| project
    JobId,
    LatestRunId,
    LatestRun_Start,
    LatestRun_End,
    LatestRun_Status,
    Duration,
    DurationSeconds,
    MaxDuration,
    MaxDurationSeconds,
    LatestRun_TasksTotal,
    LatestRun_TasksSucceeded,
    PrevRun1_Start,
    PrevRun1_End,
    PrevRun1_Status,
    PrevRun1_DurationSeconds,
    PrevRun2_Start,
    PrevRun2_End,
    PrevRun2_Status,
    PrevRun2_DurationSeconds,
    DatabricksJobUrl
| order by LatestRun_End desc

let DatabricksWorkspaceUrl = "https://adb-4498671387938000.0.azuredatabricks.net";
DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ActionName == "runFailed"
| extend 
    JobId = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).jobId),
    RunId = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).runId),
    TriggerType = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).jobTriggerType),
    TriggeredBy = tostring(parse_json(RequestParams).runCreatorUserName),
    IdentityEmail = tostring(parse_json(Identity).email),
    StatusCode = tostring(extractjson("$.statusCode", Response)),
    ErrorMessage = tostring(extractjson("$.errorMessage", Response))
| summarize 
    FailedRuns = count(),
    StatusCodes = strcat_array(make_set(StatusCode, 5), ", "),
    Errors = strcat_array(make_set(ErrorMessage, 5), " | "),
    RecentFailureTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by JobId, TriggerType, TriggeredBy
| extend DatabricksJobUrl = strcat(
    DatabricksWorkspaceUrl,
    "/jobs/",
    JobId
)

| project 
    JobId,
    TriggerType,
    RecentFailureTime,
    FailedRuns,
    StatusCodes,
    Errors,
    TriggeredBy,
    DatabricksJobUrl
| order by FailedRuns desc
| take 15

// ========================================================
// PANEL: Databricks Failed Job Runs - Failure Diagnostics
// ========================================================

// Use only the plain Databricks workspace URL.
// Do not include <a href>, ", target, title, or HTML tags.
let DatabricksWorkspaceUrl =
    "https://adb-4498671387938000.0.azuredatabricks.net";

// ================== RAW NORMALIZATION ==================
let FailedRunEvents =
    DatabricksJobs
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

    // Parse JSON columns once.
    | extend
        Params = parse_json(RequestParams),
        ResponseData = parse_json(Response),
        IdentityData = parse_json(Identity)

    // Normalize JobId, RunId, and TaskKey.
    | extend
        JobId = tostring(
            coalesce(
                tostring(Params["jobId"]),
                tostring(Params["job_id"]),
                tostring(Params["jobID"])
            )
        ),
        RunId = tostring(
            coalesce(
                tostring(Params["runId"]),
                tostring(Params["run_id"]),
                tostring(Params["jobRunId"])
            )
        ),
        TaskKey = tostring(
            coalesce(
                tostring(Params["taskKey"]),
                tostring(Params["task_key"]),
                tostring(Params["taskName"]),
                tostring(Params["task_name"])
            )
        )

    // Normalize final job status.
    | extend StatusRaw = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(ResponseData["resultState"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["result_state"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["state"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["status"]),
            tostring(Params["resultState"]),
            tostring(Params["result_state"]),
            tostring(Params["taskRunResultState"]),
            tostring(Params["jobTerminalState"]),
            tostring(Params["state"])
        )
    )
    | extend StatusUpper = toupper(trim(" ", StatusRaw))
    | extend NormalizedStatus = case(
        StatusUpper == "FAILED", "Failed",
        StatusUpper == "FAILURE", "Failed",
        StatusUpper == "ERROR", "Failed",
        StatusUpper == "INTERNAL_ERROR", "Failed",
        StatusUpper == "TIMEDOUT", "Timed Out",
        StatusUpper == "TIMEOUT", "Timed Out",
        StatusUpper == "TERMINATED", "Terminated",
        StatusUpper == "CANCELED", "Cancelled",
        StatusUpper == "CANCELLED", "Cancelled",
        StatusUpper == "SUCCESS", "Succeeded",
        StatusUpper == "SUCCEEDED", "Succeeded",
        StatusUpper == "RUNNING", "Running",
        StatusUpper == "PENDING", "Pending",
        StatusUpper == "QUEUED", "Queued",
        StatusUpper == "SKIPPED", "Skipped",
        "Unknown"
    )

    // Extract error type.
    | extend ErrorTypeRaw = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(ResponseData["errorCode"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["error_code"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["errorType"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["error_type"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["exceptionType"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["exception_type"]),
            tostring(Params["errorCode"]),
            tostring(Params["error_code"])
        )
    )

    // Extract error message.
    | extend ErrorMessageRaw = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(ResponseData["errorMessage"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["error_message"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["message"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["stackTrace"]),
            tostring(ResponseData["stack_trace"]),
            tostring(Params["errorMessage"]),
            tostring(Params["error_message"])
        )
    )

    // Extract notebook and cluster information.
    | extend NotebookPath = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(Params["notebookPath"]),
            tostring(Params["notebook_path"]),
            tostring(Params["path"])
        )
    )
    | extend ClusterId = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(Params["clusterId"]),
            tostring(Params["cluster_id"]),
            tostring(Params["existingClusterId"]),
            tostring(Params["existing_cluster_id"])
        )
    )

    // Determine the point where the run failed.
    | extend PointOfFailureRaw = case(
        isnotempty(TaskKey),
            strcat("Task: ", TaskKey),

        isnotempty(NotebookPath),
            strcat("Notebook: ", NotebookPath),

        isnotempty(ClusterId),
            strcat("Cluster: ", ClusterId),

        isnotempty(ActionName),
            strcat("Action: ", tostring(ActionName)),

        "Job level"
    )

    // First preference: runCreatorUserName from RequestParams.
    // Other properties are used only as fallback options.
    | extend TriggeredByRaw = tostring(
        coalesce(
            tostring(Params["runCreatorUserName"]),
            tostring(Params["run_creator_user_name"]),
            tostring(Params["creatorUserName"]),
            tostring(Params["userName"]),
            tostring(IdentityData["email"]),
            tostring(IdentityData["userName"]),
            tostring(IdentityData["username"]),
            tostring(IdentityData["principalName"]),
            tostring(IdentityData["servicePrincipalName"])
        )
    )

    // Use TimeGenerated as the lifecycle event timestamp.
    | extend EventTime = todatetime(TimeGenerated)

    // Keep records with valid job and run identifiers.
    | where isnotempty(JobId)
    | where isnotempty(RunId)
;

// ================== RUN TIME BOUNDARIES ==================
let RunTimeBoundaries =
    FailedRunEvents
    | summarize
        Start = min(EventTime),
        End = max(EventTime),
        EventCount = count()
      by JobId, RunId
    | extend DurationSeconds =
        datetime_diff(
            "second",
            End,
            Start
        )
    | extend DurationSeconds = iff(
        DurationSeconds < 0,
        long(0),
        DurationSeconds
    )
;

// ================== FINAL RUN DETAILS ==================
// Get the newest lifecycle record for every JobId and RunId.
let FinalRunDetails =
    FailedRunEvents
    | summarize arg_max(
        EventTime,
        NormalizedStatus,
        ErrorTypeRaw,
        ErrorMessageRaw,
        PointOfFailureRaw,
        TriggeredByRaw,
        TaskKey,
        NotebookPath,
        ClusterId
    ) by JobId, RunId
    | project
        JobId,
        RunId,
        Status = NormalizedStatus,
        ErrorTypeRaw,
        ErrorMessageRaw,
        PointOfFailureRaw,
        TriggeredByRaw
;

// ================== FINAL PANEL OUTPUT ==================
RunTimeBoundaries
| join kind=inner FinalRunDetails on JobId, RunId

// Keep failure-related terminal states.
| where Status == "Failed"
    or Status == "Timed Out"
    or Status == "Terminated"
    or Status == "Cancelled"

// Apply fallback values where logs do not contain the details.
| extend
    ErrorType = iff(
        isnotempty(ErrorTypeRaw),
        ErrorTypeRaw,
        case(
            Status == "Timed Out", "TIMEOUT",
            Status == "Terminated", "TERMINATED",
            Status == "Cancelled", "CANCELLED",
            "UNCLASSIFIED_FAILURE"
        )
    ),
    ErrorMessage = iff(
        isnotempty(ErrorMessageRaw),
        ErrorMessageRaw,
        "Error message was not available in the Databricks audit log."
    ),
    PointOfFailure = iff(
        isnotempty(PointOfFailureRaw),
        PointOfFailureRaw,
        "Unknown"
    ),
    TriggeredBy = iff(
        isnotempty(TriggeredByRaw),
        TriggeredByRaw,
        "Unknown"
    )

// Create direct Databricks links.
//
// DatabricksRunUrl redirects to the specific job run.
// DatabricksJobUrl redirects to the overall job page.
| extend
    DatabricksRunUrl = strcat(
        DatabricksWorkspaceUrl,
        "/jobs/",
        tostring(JobId),
        "/runs/",
        tostring(RunId)
    ),
    DatabricksJobUrl = strcat(
        DatabricksWorkspaceUrl,
        "/jobs/",
        tostring(JobId)
    )

// Final table columns.
| project
    JobId = tostring(JobId),
    RunId = tostring(RunId),
    Status,
    Start,
    End,
    Duration = DurationSeconds,
    ErrorType,
    ErrorMessage,
    PointOfFailure,
    TriggeredBy,
    DatabricksRunUrl,
    DatabricksJobUrl

| order by End desc

// ========================================================
// PANEL: Critical Deviation Jobs
// Follows the Grafana dashboard time picker
// ========================================================

let DatabricksWorkspaceUrl =
    "https://adb-4498671387938000.0.azuredatabricks.net";

// ================== RUN START EVENTS ==================
let StartedJobs =
    DatabricksJobs
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where ActionName == "runStart"
    | extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
    | extend
        StartTime = todatetime(TimeGenerated),
        JobId = tostring(Params["jobId"]),
        JobName = tostring(Params["taskKey"]),
        RunId = tostring(Params["runId"])
    | where isnotempty(JobId)
        and isnotempty(RunId)
    | summarize
        StartTime = min(StartTime),
        JobName = take_any(JobName)
      by JobId, RunId;

// ================== RUN SUCCESS EVENTS ==================
let SucceededJobs =
    DatabricksJobs
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where ActionName == "runSucceeded"
    | extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
    | extend
        EndTime = todatetime(TimeGenerated),
        JobId = tostring(Params["jobId"]),
        JobName = tostring(Params["taskKey"]),
        RunId = tostring(Params["runId"])
    | where isnotempty(JobId)
        and isnotempty(RunId)
    | summarize
        EndTime = max(EndTime),
        JobName = take_any(JobName)
      by JobId, RunId;

// ================== JOIN START AND SUCCESS EVENTS ==================
StartedJobs
| join kind=inner SucceededJobs on JobId, RunId

// Use the available job name from either event.
| extend JobName = coalesce(JobName, JobName1)

// Calculate duration for every completed successful run.
| extend DurationSec = datetime_diff(
    "second",
    EndTime,
    StartTime
)
| where DurationSec >= 0

// ================== PANEL CALCULATION ==================
| summarize
    LastRunDuration = max(DurationSec),
    AvgPast3Runs = avg(todouble(DurationSec)),
    LastRunTime = max(EndTime)
  by JobId, JobName

| extend PercentDeviation = iff(
    isnull(AvgPast3Runs)
        or AvgPast3Runs == 0,
    real(0),
    round(
        (
            (
                todouble(LastRunDuration)
                - AvgPast3Runs
            )
            / AvgPast3Runs
        ) * 100.0,
        2
    )
)

// Show jobs with more than 20% deviation.
| where PercentDeviation > 20

// Create Databricks job URL.
| extend DatabricksJobUrl = strcat(
    DatabricksWorkspaceUrl,
    "/jobs/",
    tostring(JobId)
)

| project
    JobId,
    JobName,
    LastRunTime,
    LastRunDuration,
    AvgPast3Runs = round(AvgPast3Runs, 2),
    PercentDeviation,
    DatabricksJobUrl

| order by PercentDeviation desc
